title: City Place Stop
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D neighborhood storybook, friendly streets and buildings, clean isolated subjects; visual identity: City Place Stop

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child navigating city streets with an adult
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make City Place Stop a stop-and-cross navigation song: crosswalk, intersection, road, overpass, exit/zone signs, transit and pedestrian places teach how movement through a city is organized.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child pauses at every traffic conflict and reads infrastructure before continuing; shops and parks become destinations rather than road rules.
